title: Coarsen SIRead predicate-lock granularity to cut per-txn lock bookkeeping
configuration_cause: max_pred_locks_per_page=2 and max_pred_locks_per_relation=-2 keep SIRead locks at fine page granularity, so each GetUserTweets scan accumulates many predicate-lock entries (locks_total p95 up to 7728 in controls) and inflates per-transaction lock bookkeeping on the dominant 88%-terminal-capacity transaction.
mechanism: GetUserTweets dominates terminal capacity (0.88) and its p99 (1092us) is ~6x its p50 (171us). With max_pred_locks_per_page=2 and max_pred_locks_per_relation=-2, SERIALIZABLE SIRead locks are retained at fine page granularity, so each scan touches many lock entries; locks_total p95 reaches 7728 while lock_waiting stays 0, indicating bookkeeping cost rather than blocking. Raising page granularity to 8 and relation cap to 4 promotes SIRead locks to coarser relation-level entries, reducing per-transaction lock churn and tail latency on the dominant transaction, freeing terminal capacity for higher goodput.
query_effect: GetUserTweets scans retain fewer SIRead lock entries per call; predicate-lock promotion to relation granularity reduces lock-manager work per transaction without introducing blocking.
expected_tps_effect: Modest increase in successful transaction TPS as terminal capacity consumed by GetUserTweets lock bookkeeping shrinks.
expected_latency_effect: GetUserTweets p99 decreases; p50 roughly unchanged.

predictions.rationale: Coarser SIRead granularity retains fewer lock entries per scan.
Less lock bookkeeping reduces tail latency on dominant transaction.

alternatives.statement: If the tail is WAL-sync driven rather than lock-bookkeeping driven, coarsening predicate locks will not move locks_total and TPS stays flat.
If coarsening introduces relation-level blocking, lock_waiting_backends.max rises above 0 and TPS falls.

why_exceeds_incumbent: Targets the dominant 88%-terminal-capacity transaction's lock bookkeeping with a bounded, reversible reload-class change; prior WAL-path actions were inconclusive/refuted, so this tests the competing predicate-lock mechanism.

knob_changes.numerical_basis: Raise from 2 to 8 within safe [0,256]; 4x coarser page-level SIRead retention, well below tuple-lock exhaustion.
Raise from -2 to 4 within safe [-2,4096]; positive cap of 4 coarsens relation-level promotion.

nodes.label: Coarser SIRead locking reduces per-txn lock bookkeeping

cross_domain_requirements: If locks_total falls but TPS is flat, memory_storage should test WAL sync batching as the residual tail source.
